notes.title: Getting Closer To A Major Update!
notes.content: [p]My goal is to have the major update out before September 2025. It will still be in early access after the update. I redid the Cartographer, (the level editor), for designing star systems. The star systems are going to be humongous! Traveling the impulse speed of the USS Enterprise in this game will take the player more than 10 hours (in real life sitting in front of the computer) to travel from one side of any star system to another! Don't worry there will be faster than light travel options even in star systems ;)   Well... if you have the fuel.[/p][p]Lately I've been working on the asteroid fields. The video in this post shows flying through a star system designed using the Cartographer in game. In the video there are four asteroid fields each with several thousands of space rocks. In the Cartographer players will be able to set the density of asteroid fields. For testing purposes each of the four asteroid fields was set to maximum density. When all four asteroid fields became fully visible the FPS tanked to 10! I still need to clean that up. The video is just a test. [/p][previewyoutube="YVTmvbVRVSQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Edit: It's past 2am in the morning where I am July 31, 2025.[/p][p]I just finished coding some improvements to the asteroid fields which has greatly improved the FPS. There are over 19,000 individual asteroids in the star system in this video! Each one is a 3D model that can be interacted with. It's better than the previous video (above) but still needs improving. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="YnRNInK7hY4;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Another update and controls explained
notes.content:
Camera movement updated - it was too slow

[u]Controls[/u]

Left mouse button  --- select controls and place pieces by clicking on red connection nodes

Right mouse button --- hold down to rotate camera around ship being built

MIddle mouse button --- hold down and drag to move ship model to position desired

Mouse Scroll Wheel --- roll forward and back to zoom in and out

After saving a design the 3d OBJ model and textures are saved to the directory Documents/My Games/4X Space Time Shipyard/

:)

Press escape key to exit application.
